Create a cohesive 16-bit SNES/Sega-era RPG village in crisp pixel art, viewed from a top-down three-quarter perspective, with the warmth and richly detailed atmosphere of a classic Final Fantasy adventure translated into a consistent tiled world. Use a warm palette of honey-colored timber, cream plaster, terracotta roofs, mossy greens, golden paths, and clear turquoise water; use dark brown outlines, deliberate pixel clusters, restrained stepped shading, and no smooth gradients or antialiasing.
